Dancefloor Magic

Dancefloor Magic bring 350+ hits, powerhouse vocals & irresistible soul, R&B, and pop energy with a dazzling brass section for a truly unforgettable party.

About Dancefloor Magic

Dancefloor Magic is a vibrant, feel-good 5 to 7-piece party band delivering slick, soulful takes on Motown, soul, R&amp;B , and dancefloor anthems . With over 350 songs in their repertoire and lineups to suit every stage, they bring serious style, energy, and talent to weddings, parties, and events across the UK. At the heart of the band is Ione , a magnetic frontwoman with a background in gospel, West End musicals ( Thriller Live , Beautiful ), and performances alongside Sam Smith , Pete Doherty , and on Jools Holland . Her vocals are rich, soulful , and packed with character. Backed by a killer lineup of pro session musicians —featuring bass, guitar, drums, keys, sax, and trumpet —Dancefloor Magic blends musicianship and showmanship in equal measure. With a dedicated band manager, customisable setlists , playlist music between sets, and optional band-member DJ , they make event planning seamless. Expect big tunes , warm vibes , and a packed dancefloor all night long.
